record.field: External sales representative. Sees only the partners where they are a commercial agent (via commercial_partner_id.agent_ids) and the sale orders / invoices where they are the rep snapshot. Does NOT extend Sales/Account stock groups — ACLs are declared explicitly for this group.

Operational reviewer for orders placed by external sales representatives. Validates stock availability, fiscal setup and delivery timing before the order is confirmed. Does NOT approve pricing discounts — that role belongs to Sales Manager / Director. Assign this group to the checker user alongside a sale.order access group (e.g. sales_team.group_sale_salesman) so the checker can see the orders they need to validate.
